name: Technology
summary: Build scalable software and AI-powered products.
description: SaaS and technology UI UX design: web apps, dashboards, developer tools and AI product interfaces, built on design systems that grow with your product.
image_alt: Developer pointing at code on a monitor, technology industry
overview:
Technology products often do powerful things behind confusing screens. New users struggle to see the value, and power users hit walls as features pile up. My job is to make complex systems easy to understand: clear navigation, useful dashboards and AI features that explain what they are doing.

I work with founders and product teams on SaaS web apps and mobile products, from the first prototype to a design system that engineers can build from directly. My work includes KADUU, a dark web intelligence workspace, and Nimbus, a monitoring dashboard teams actually check.

challenges.title: Complexity creep
challenges.text: Each new feature adds settings and screens until the product is hard to learn.

challenges.title: Activation and onboarding
challenges.text: New users leave if they cannot reach a useful result in their first session.

challenges.title: Data-heavy screens
challenges.text: Dashboards, tables and logs have to show a lot of information without turning into noise.

challenges.title: Trust in AI features
challenges.text: Users need to see what the AI did, why it did it and how to correct it.

faqs.question: Do you have experience designing SaaS products?
faqs.answer: Yes. I designed KADUU, a dark web intelligence workspace, and Nimbus, a monitoring dashboard. You can see both case studies on this page.

faqs.question: Can you design AI features for our product?
faqs.answer: Yes. I design AI assistants and AI-assisted workflows with clear inputs, visible results and easy ways to review, edit or undo what the AI does.

faqs.question: Can you work with our existing design system?
faqs.answer: Yes. I can extend and clean up an existing system, or create one from scratch with tokens and components that match your codebase.

faqs.question: Can you improve an existing product without a full redesign?
faqs.answer: Yes. I start with an audit of the current product, then improve the most important flows step by step, so your team can ship changes without a rebuild.

faqs.question: How do we start?
faqs.answer: Send me a short brief through the contact page. We will have a call about your product, users and timeline, and I will come back with a plan and quote.
